exposure: Patients with Crohn disease with previous inflammatory bowel disease surgery
single-agent antitumor necrosis factor treatment vs. no inflammatory bowel disease medication
cohort: 322 pregnant patients with inflammatory bowel disease who delivered at the study institution between 2012 and 2019
finding: Antepartum biologic use, specifically antitumor necrosis factor alpha therapy, is associated with an increased risk of maternal infectious and hypertensive outcomes in pregnant women with inflammatory bowel disease.
